scoring_proposal: Report affected_by_deletion for the damage and lost for original nodes still missing after repair. Recover coordinates from byte-identical restoration at the corresponding edit boundaries and compare the actual graph. Extra unrelated copies receive no restoration credit.

analyzer_proposal.basis: The requested mutation deliberately makes compilable inputs defeat the production analyzer.
analyzer_proposal.method: Use hash-verified existing tool observations and a benign synthetic missing-graph-fact negative scoring test. Report these separately from live source mutations. No new crash-triggering rewrite or corpus reproduction.
analyzer_proposal.scope: Compiler input/diagnostic operators and the 200 unmodified controls proceed under their existing criteria.

independent_work: Verify source/graph membership, grouping and unmodified controls.
